text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: “Avenge the Israelites on the Midianites; afterward you shall be gathered to your people. ”
text_cn: “你应在米德杨人身上为以色列子民报仇，以后你就要归到你亲族那里去。”

text_en: So Moses said to the people, “Arm some of your number for the war, so that they may go against Midian, to execute the Lord ’s vengeance on Midian.
text_cn: 梅瑟于是吩咐人民说：“你们要选拔壮丁，武装起来，准备作战，进攻米德杨，在他们身上为上主雪仇。

text_en: You shall send a thousand from each of the tribes of Israel to the war. ”
text_cn: 以色列每支派应派遣一千人出征作战。”

text_en: So out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe were conscripted, twelve thousand armed for battle.
text_cn: 这样，每支派出一千人，以色列的部队共有一万二千武装出征的人。

text_en: Moses sent them to the war, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for sounding the alarm in his hand.
text_cn: 梅瑟就派遣他们──每支派一千人，出征作战，并派遣大司祭厄肋阿匝尔的儿子丕乃哈斯与他们同去，手内带着圣器和发号令的喇叭，

text_en: They did battle against Midian, as the Lord had commanded Moses, and killed every male.
text_cn: 他们遂照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的，攻击了米德杨，杀了所有的男子。

text_en: They killed the kings of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian, in addition to others who were slain by them; and they also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
text_cn: 除这些被杀的以外，还杀了米德杨五个王子：厄威、勒耿、族尔、胡尔和勒巴；也用刀杀了贝敖尔的儿子巴郎。

text_en: The Israelites took the women of Midian and their little ones captive; and they took all their cattle, their flocks, and all their goods as booty.
text_cn: 以色列子民俘掳了米德杨人的妇女和幼童，掠夺了他们所有的牲畜、羊群和财产；

text_en: All their towns where they had settled, and all their encampments, they burned,
text_cn: 火烧了他们所住的一切城邑和营寨。

text_en: but they took all the spoil and all the booty, both people and animals.
text_cn: 以后把一切所抢所夺之物，人和牲畜都带走，

text_en: Then they brought the captives and the booty and the spoil to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the Israelites, at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
text_cn: 把俘掳和所抢所夺之物，带到梅瑟和大司祭厄肋阿匝尔以及以色列子民全会众那里，即带到耶里哥的对面，约但河边，摩阿布旷野中的营盘那里。

text_en: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.
text_cn: 梅瑟和大司祭厄肋阿匝尔以及会众各首领，都到营外欢迎他们。

text_en: Moses became angry with the officers of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, who had come from service in the war.
text_cn: 梅瑟对作战回来的军官、千夫长和百夫长大发忿怒，

text_en: Moses said to them, “Have you allowed all the women to live?
text_cn: 向他们说：“你们为什么还让这一切妇女活着？

text_en: These women here, on Balaam’s advice, made the Israelites act treacherously against the Lord in the affair of Peor, so that the plague came among the congregation of the Lord .
text_cn: 看正是她们听了巴郎的话诱惑了以色列子民，在培敖尔事件上违背了上主，致使灾祸降在上主的会众身上。

text_en: Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man by sleeping with him.
text_cn: 如今应将所有的男童杀死，将所有认识过男人，与男人同过房的女人，都一律杀掉。

text_en: But all the young girls who have not known a man by sleeping with him, keep alive for yourselves.
text_cn: 至于那些没有与男人来往同过房的女童，可为你们保留。

text_en: Camp outside the camp seven days; whoever of you has killed any person or touched a corpse, purify yourselves and your captives on the third and on the seventh day.
text_cn: 你们应七天住在营外；你们和你们的俘虏，凡杀过人，或接触过尸首的，应在第三天和第七天上取洁；

text_en: You shall purify every garment, every article of skin, everything made of goats’ hair, and every article of wood. ”
text_cn: 对所有的衣服、皮具、毛织品和木器，都应行取洁礼。”

text_en: Eleazar the priest said to the troops who had gone to battle: “This is the statute of the law that the Lord has commanded Moses:
text_cn: 大司祭厄肋阿匝尔对作战回来的军队说：“这是上主吩咐梅瑟的法令：

text_en: gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—
text_cn: 金银、铜、铁、锡、铅，

text_en: everything that can withstand fire, shall be passed through fire, and it shall be clean. Nevertheless it shall also be purified with the water for purification; and whatever cannot withstand fire, shall be passed through the water.
text_cn: 凡能耐火之物，应经过火，再以取洁水取洁，才算洁净；凡不能耐火之物，应经过水洗。

text_en: You must wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean; afterward you may come into the camp. ”
text_cn: 第七天应洗你们的衣服，你们才算洁净，然后方可回营。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
text_cn: 上主又训示梅瑟说：

text_en: “You and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the ancestral houses of the congregation make an inventory of the booty captured, both human and animal.
text_cn: “你和厄肋阿匝尔司祭以及会众的家长，应统计一下掠夺的胜利品，无论是人或牲畜，

text_en: Divide the booty into two parts, between the warriors who went out to battle and all the congregation.
text_cn: 然后把胜利品平分，一半给出征作战的兵士，一半给其余全体会众。

text_en: From the share of the warriors who went out to battle, set aside as tribute for the Lord , one item out of every five hundred, whether persons, oxen, donkeys, sheep, or goats.
text_cn: 由出征作战的兵士所得的一份中，抽出五百分之一，不论是人、牛、驴或羊，奉献给上主；

text_en: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 把所取出的交给厄肋阿匝尔司祭，作为属于上主的献仪。

text_en: But from the Israelites’ half you shall take one out of every fifty, whether persons, oxen, donkeys, sheep, or goats—all the animals—and give them to the Levites who have charge of the tabernacle of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 由以色列子民分得的一半中，应抽出五十分之一，不论是人、牛、驴、羊，或是其他牲畜，交给那些在上主会幕内服务的肋未人。”

text_en: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord had commanded Moses:
text_cn: 梅瑟和厄肋阿匝尔司祭就照上主吩咐梅瑟的做了。

text_en: The booty remaining from the spoil that the troops had taken totaled six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
text_cn: 作战部队所掠夺的物品尚存的战利品，计有羊六十七万五千只，

text_en: seventy-two thousand oxen,
text_cn: 牛七万二千头，

text_en: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
text_cn: 驴六万一千匹；

text_en: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, women who had not known a man by sleeping with him.
text_cn: 人口，尚未与男人来往同过房的女人，计有三万二千。

text_en: The half-share, the portion of those who had gone out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep and goats,
text_cn: 出征作战所得的一半，计羊三十三万七千五百只；

text_en: and the Lord ’s tribute of sheep and goats was six hundred seventy-five.
text_cn: 由这些羊中，给上主作献仪的，为六百七十五只；

text_en: The oxen were thirty-six thousand, of which the Lord ’s tribute was seventy-two.
text_cn: 牛三万六千头，给上主作献仪的，为七十二头；

text_en: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the Lord ’s tribute was sixty-one.
text_cn: 驴三万五百匹，给上主作献仪的，为六十一匹；

text_en: The persons were sixteen thousand, of which the Lord ’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
text_cn: 人口一万六千，给上主作献仪的，为三十二人。

text_en: Moses gave the tribute, the offering for the Lord , to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 梅瑟就照上主对他所吩咐的，将取出作为上主献仪的一份，交给了厄肋阿匝尔司祭。

text_en: As for the Israelites’ half, which Moses separated from that of the troops,
text_cn: 至于梅瑟分配给以色列子民的那一半，即与作战的兵士平分出来的，

text_en: the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep and goats,
text_cn: 那属于会众的一半，计有羊三十三万七千五百只，

text_en: thirty-six thousand oxen,
text_cn: 牛三万六千头，

text_en: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
text_cn: 驴三万五百匹，

text_en: and sixteen thousand persons.
text_cn: 人口一万六千。

text_en: From the Israelites’ half Moses took one of every fifty, both of persons and of animals, and gave them to the Levites who had charge of the tabernacle of the Lord ; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 梅瑟照上主对他所吩咐的，由属于以色列子民的这一半，抽出五十分之一的人和牲畜，交给了那些在上主会幕内服务的肋未人。

text_en: Then the officers who were over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, approached Moses,
text_cn: 出征作战的军官，千夫长和百夫长，来到梅瑟前，

text_en: and said to Moses, “Your servants have counted the warriors who are under our command, and not one of us is missing.
text_cn: 对他说：“你的仆人们调查了所属的作战士兵，一个也没有少。

text_en: And we have brought the Lord ’s offering, what each of us found, articles of gold, armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and pendants, to make atonement for ourselves before the Lord . ”
text_cn: 为此我们每人将所获得的金器，如臂镯、腕镯、戒指、耳环和项链，献于上主作献仪，好在上主面前为我们赎罪。”

text_en: Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from them, all in the form of crafted articles.
text_cn: 梅瑟和厄肋阿匝尔司祭由他们手中接受了这一切金制物品。

text_en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered to the Lord , from the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
text_cn: 千夫长和百夫长献给上主作献仪的金子，共计一万六千七百五十“协刻耳”。

text_en: (The troops had all taken plunder for themselves. )
text_cn: 兵丁所掠夺的东西，各归己有。

text_en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord .
text_cn: 梅瑟和厄肋阿匝尔司祭遂将由千夫长和百夫长所收下的金子，带入会幕内，好使上主记念以色列子民。
